shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---'; rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' | sed -n '1,160p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- next docs cache refs ---'; rg -n \"revalidateTag|updateTag|unstable_cache|use cache|cacheTag\" node_modules/next/dist/docs -g '*.md' | sed -n '1,220p'"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- package.json ---'; cat package.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- next config ---'; cat next.config.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- page ---'; sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- db ---'; sed -n '1,260p' lib/db.js; printf '%s\\n' '--- revalidating guide ---'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/09-revalidating.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- cache guide relevant ---'; rg -n -C 5 \"database|cacheTag\\('products'\\)|use cache\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/07-caching-and-revalidating.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-caching.md 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,260p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/caching-without-cache-components.md 2>/dev/null || rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | rg 'caching-without-cache-components|unstable_cache|revalidateTag' | sed -n '1,80p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- server actions form docs ---'; rg -n -C 8 \"inline|<form action=|Server Function\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app -g '*.md' | rg -m 12 -B 8 -A 20 \"form action|inline\""
/bin/bash -lc "cat tsconfig.json; printf '\\n--- layout ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' app/layout.tsx; printf '\\n--- global files ---\\n'; rg --files app"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx tsconfig.json; printf '\\n--- status ---\\n'; git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"lib\": [
-      \"dom\",
-      \"dom.iterable\",
-      \"esnext\"
-    ],
+    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
@@
-    \"paths\": {
-      \"@/*\": [
-        \"./*\"
-      ]
-    }
+    \"paths\": {
+      \"@/*\": [\"./*\"]
+    }
   },
-  \"include\": [
-    \"next-env.d.ts\",
-    \"**/*.ts\",
-    \"**/*.tsx\",
-    \".next/types/**/*.ts\",
-    \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"
-  ],
-  \"exclude\": [
-    \"node_modules\"
-  ]
+  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\"],
+  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\"]
 }
*** End Patch
PATCH
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts
git diff --check -- app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx tsconfig.json
printf '\\n--- final diff ---\\n'
git diff -- app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,90p'; nl -ba app/layout.tsx | sed -n '1,30p'; git status --short"
